_doc: Higgs production cross sections at MH=125 assuming BR(H -> long-lived pair) = 1.
_note: JMTucker multiplies xsec by filterEff at load time. Kamui keeps them separate.

WplusH._derivation: 3 x 9.541e-02, inclusive W+H 0.8502 times BR(W to lv), once per lepton flavor

WminusH._derivation: 3 x 5.981e-02, inclusive W-H 0.5328 times BR(W to lv), once per lepton flavor

ZH._derivation: 3 x 2.596e-02, qq-initiated ZH to llH, total ZH per flavor 2.996e-02 minus the gg component 3.995e-03

ggZH._derivation: 3 x 3.995e-03, gg-initiated ZH to llH, inclusive ggZH 0.1184 times BR(Z to ll), once per lepton flavor

_filterEffNote: The ggH => SS => 4d samples carry a generator filter depending on the scalar mass.
